inventory.interpretation: The 186 aggregate observer frames are not 186 unique opaque class records. The source capture map contains 74 opaque carriers plus 112 standard-object frames. Bounded physical AC1021 routes now qualify 67 opaque carriers: 25 VISUALSTYLE, 17 SCALE, 12 DICTIONARYVAR, three MATERIAL, one DBCOLOR, one ACDBDICTIONARYWDFLT, one ACDBPLACEHOLDER, two ACDBSECTIONVIEWSTYLE, two ACDBDETAILVIEWSTYLE, one MLEADERSTYLE, one TABLESTYLE, and one CELLSTYLEMAP. They qualify 76 standard-object frames; these selected graph routes verify ASCII/Binary output and typed/raw readback, with applicable dependency closure, mutation/refusal, and retry checks. The children-room TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP route adds two typed carriers and its two owner/extension dictionaries using a second physical source profile. The remaining seven opaque carriers and 36 standard-object frames remain unqualified; source-byte capture or matching typed callbacks alone do not qualify serialization.
